name: Great Zimbabwe (state)
notes: Chirikure, Pollard, Manyanga, Bandama, "A Bayesian Chronology for Great Zimbabwe: Re-threading the Sequence of a Vandalised Monument," Antiquity 87 (2013): 1-19 — modern methodological benchmark; stone construction begins c. 1200 CE (later than older "11th century" popular framing), architectural peak 14th-15th c., occupation continuing into 16th-17th c. Much original stratigraphy destroyed by Richard Nicklin Hall's 1902-4 excavation (funded by Cecil Rhodes/BSAC with an explicit brief to establish non-African origin) — flagged as a documented act of evidentiary destruction entangled with racist settler-colonial historiography, not a neutral methodological gap.
